text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple GitHub Actions runners failing to install packages from GitHub Packages (npm). Affects CI jobs across `redwood-inference/backend` and `redwood-inference/ops` — causing hotfix build-and-deploy pipelines to fail. Pager: @oncall.

alex: seeing consistent failures in the `install` step: `npm ERR! 502 Bad Gateway - GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/: 502`. All recent runs fail within the first minute.

maria: confirmed — attempts to re-run a few jobs result in same error. This blocks hotfix for production auth bug.

jordan: any chance to switch to public registry for non-private deps? we have private packages hosted on GH Packages, so `npmjs` won't work for those.

devops: thinking through mitigations: 1) build release artifacts locally (or on our private runners) and upload to S3/release-bucket 2) change deploy pipeline to pull artifacts from S3 instead of doing fresh `npm ci` 3) if needed, bring up a temporary self-hosted runner that has cached node_modules.

eng-lead: we should hold any automated canary rollout until we confirm artifact integrity. Manual approvals only.

vendor-github: thanks for the report — GitHub status shows `Investigating` for Packages / Actions. We'll subscribe to updates and post here. (This is the GitHub status monitor account).

support: customer impact: two enterprise customers filed high-priority tickets asking why hotfix didn't deploy. Estimated affected internal deploys: 6 runs blocked in the last 30m. Escalating to SRE for manual deploy assistance.

alex: quick logs:
```
npm ERR! code E502
npm ERR! 502 Bad Gateway - GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/registry/@redwood-inference/core
```

jordan: I'm starting a manual build on a bastion with cached artifacts. If successful I'll upload `tar.gz` to `s3://redwood-releases/hotfix/1795023000/` and post the URL.

devops: snippet to fetch/upload we used:
```
./scripts/build-release.sh --tag hotfix-1795023000
aws s3 cp dist/release.tar.gz s3://redwood-releases/hotfix/1795023000/release.tar.gz
```
Then modify deploy pipeline variable `RELEASE_SOURCE=s3://redwood-releases/hotfix/1795023000/release.tar.gz` and kick manual deploy.

maria: I'm taking oncall handoff at 1795023300 — @sophie will be next after me. I'll coordinate the manual deploy with @devops and @alex.

sophie: acknowledged, watching for handoff.

vendor-github: Update: We are seeing elevated error rates in Actions and Packages for some customers. Engineers are investigating the backend package routing. No ETA yet.

alex: manual build succeeded, uploaded to S3, changed pipeline to pull artifact and started manual deploy to staging for smoke tests.

support: informing customers: "We're currently experiencing a third-party outage affecting our CI/deploy pipelines (GitHub Actions / Packages). We have a manual workaround in place to build and deploy hotfixes; ETA for affected deploys: 60-90 minutes. Will follow up with confirmation."

eng-lead: keep canary paused until we get clean smoke tests. No automatic promotions.

maria: staging smoke passed. Initiating manual production deploy now (with @devops running the steps). Tracking all commands in the incident runbook channel.

devops: production deploy completed at 1795023410. Observability shows auth error rate returning to baseline. Rolling back not needed.

vendor-github: Update: Partial restoration observed; some package fetches are still failing intermittently. We're continuing to monitor.

support: I've replied to the two enterprise tickets with the remediation summary and ETA. Customers acknowledged.

alex: follow-up note — created a temporary job in our Confluence runbook with the manual artifact workflow and commands used. Will link in postmortem.

maria: current status: service functionality restored for our customers who needed hotfixes. CI is still failing for some jobs that rely on GH Packages; we should consider longer-term work: 1) cache more artifacts in S3 for critical hotfixes 2) add fallback to our private runners 3) evaluate mirrored package registry.

eng-lead: set severity P2 (third-party outage with workaround and manual mitigations). Postmortem owner: @maria. Action items: add S3 artifact fallback, automate private-runner cold cache, runbook update.

incident-bot: Handoff note: oncall change at 1795023300 (maria -> sophie).

vendor-github: Final: Services fully restored for Packages and Actions. We recommend retrying failed jobs. We'll follow up with a detailed incident timeline.

maria: marking thread for post-incident writeup. Postmortem due in 72 hours. Assigning owners: `maria` (write), `devops` (infra changes), `alex` (runbook docs).

support: closing customer communications loop once CI is green.

sophie: taking final watch for 60m, ping if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
